description: This source file implements serialization and deserialization traits for SkImageInfo and related enums for Mojo IPC, specifically for image info traits in Skia, including color space and transfer function handling.

methods.name: MakeSkImageInfo
methods.description: Creates an SkImageInfo object with optional color space based on transfer function and XYZ matrix data.

methods.name: EnumTraits<skia::mojom::AlphaType, SkAlphaType>::ToMojom
methods.description: Converts SkAlphaType enum to Mojo enum representation.

methods.name: EnumTraits<skia::mojom::AlphaType, SkAlphaType>::FromMojom
methods.description: Converts Mojo enum representation back to SkAlphaType.

methods.name: EnumTraits<skia::mojom::ColorType, SkColorType>::ToMojom
methods.description: Converts SkColorType enum to Mojo enum representation.

methods.name: EnumTraits<skia::mojom::ColorType, SkColorType>::FromMojom
methods.description: Converts Mojo enum representation back to SkColorType.

methods.name: StructTraits<skia::mojom::ImageInfoDataView, SkImageInfo>::width
methods.description: Returns the width of SkImageInfo as uint32_t.

methods.name: StructTraits<skia::mojom::ImageInfoDataView, SkImageInfo>::height
methods.description: Returns the height of SkImageInfo as uint32_t.

methods.name: StructTraits<skia::mojom::ImageInfoDataView, SkImageInfo>::color_transfer_function
methods.description: Serializes the transfer function of the color space into a vector of floats.

methods.name: StructTraits<skia::mojom::ImageInfoDataView, SkImageInfo>::color_to_xyz_matrix
methods.description: Serializes the color to XYZ matrix of the color space into a vector of floats.

methods.name: StructTraits<skia::mojom::ImageInfoDataView, SkImageInfo>::Read
methods.description: Deserializes data view into SkImageInfo, reconstructing color type, alpha type, width, height, and color space.

methods.name: StructTraits<skia::mojom::BitmapN32ImageInfoDataView, SkImageInfo>::Read
methods.description: Deserializes data view into SkImageInfo with fixed color type for 32-bit images.
